title: Marlowe & Finch Unlimited Shipping and Return Label Benefit
content:
**Customer care standard — applying the Marlowe & Finch Unlimited benefit**

**Standard.** An order placed while the membership is in status trial, active or cancellation pending ships free on the plan's covered delivery services, with no minimum order. A plan with a Same-Day Courier discount takes that percentage off the Same-Day Courier fee. The Alaska and Hawaii surcharge is never waived. A plan that covers return labels waives the return method fee. Each use is recorded at the list fee waived. When a covered order was charged a shipping fee although the membership was in a benefit status on its placed date, the fee is refunded if the member asks no later than 7 calendar days after the order is placed.

**Basis of judgement.** The status that counts is the status the membership record shows for that same membership on the order's placed date; trial, active and cancellation pending are the benefit statuses, and past due and expired are not.

## Condition, judgement, result

| Condition | Judgement | Result |
|---|---|---|
| Order placed in a benefit status, on a delivery service the plan covers | Benefit applies | Shipping fee 0.00, any order value |
| Order placed in a benefit status, Same-Day Courier, plan with a discount | Benefit applies | The plan's percentage off the Same-Day Courier fee |
| Order to Alaska or Hawaii in a benefit status | Surcharge not covered | The surcharge is charged on every plan |
| Return on a plan that covers return labels | Benefit applies | Return method fee waived |
| Covered order charged a shipping fee although placed in a benefit status; member asks no later than 7 calendar days after the placed date | Missed benefit | Shipping fee refunded |

## Plan coverage read by this standard

| Plan | Covered delivery services | Same-Day Courier discount | Return method fee waived |
|---|---|---|---|
| Unlimited Standard Monthly | Economy Ground, Pickup Point Delivery, Standard Ground | 0 percent | No |
| Unlimited Student Annual | Economy Ground, Pickup Point Delivery, Standard Ground | 0 percent | No |
| Unlimited Standard Annual | Economy Ground, Pickup Point Delivery, Standard Ground | 0 percent | No |
| Unlimited Express Monthly | Economy Ground, Pickup Point Delivery, Standard Ground, Expedited 2-Day | 0 percent | Yes |
| Unlimited Express Annual | Economy Ground, Pickup Point Delivery, Standard Ground, Expedited 2-Day | 0 percent | Yes |
| Unlimited Next-Day Annual | Economy Ground, Pickup Point Delivery, Standard Ground, Expedited 2-Day, Next Business Day | 50 percent | Yes |

## How a use appears on the membership ledger

Each benefit use is an entry for one order and one kind of benefit — free shipping, same-day discount or free return label — dated with the order's placed date, or for a return label with the return's authorization date, and valued at the list fee of the delivery service or label waived.

## Hypothetical cases

- An Expedited 2-Day order placed by an Unlimited Express Monthly member whose membership is in status cancellation pending ships free.
- An Expedited 2-Day order placed by an Unlimited Standard Annual member pays its shipping fee: the service is not covered by that plan.
- A Standard Ground order placed on 5 June, in a benefit status, was charged a shipping fee. A request on 12 June, the seventh calendar day after the placed date, is within the window and the fee is refunded; a request on 13 June falls outside the 7-day window.
